name: Elf
description: Elves are long-lived people touched by the Feywild. Their surroundings can shape a lineage over generations, producing traditions such as drow, high elves, and wood elves.

grants.name: Darkvision
grants.description: You have Darkvision out to 60 feet.

grants.name: Elven Lineage
grants.description: Choose a lineage. Its level 3 and 5 spells are always prepared; each can be cast once without a spell slot per Long Rest or with an appropriate spell slot.

options.name: Drow
options.description: Level 1: Darkvision increases to 120 feet and you know Dancing Lights. Level 3: Faerie Fire. Level 5: Darkness.

options.name: High Elf
options.description: Level 1: Prestidigitation, replaceable with another Wizard cantrip after a Long Rest. Level 3: Detect Magic. Level 5: Misty Step.

options.name: Wood Elf
options.description: Level 1: Speed 35 feet and Druidcraft. Level 3: Longstrider. Level 5: Pass without Trace.

grants.name: Lineage Spellcasting Ability
grants.description: Choose the spellcasting ability used by your Elven Lineage spells.

grants.name: Fey Ancestry
grants.description: You have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

grants.name: Keen Senses
grants.description: Gain proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

grants.name: Trance
grants.description: You need no sleep, magic can't put you to sleep, and you can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of conscious, trancelike meditation.
